value.text:
We need to evaluate each claim against the evidence. The claims are numbered 1-13. We must check if each claim is fully supported by the cited evidence IDs. If any claim has factual problems (overstatements, wrong numbers, dates, suppliers, causes not stated, products/NDCs not in evidence), we flag it in unsupported list with claim text, agent, and why.

We must output JSON with key "unsupported" containing list of objects. If all supported, empty list.

Let's examine each claim.

Claim 1: investigator: "Our package NDC 0409-4279-02 is listed on the FDA shortage list as "Available" updated 10/21/2026." Cited: [shortage-0409-4279-02]. Evidence says: "FDA shortage list: Lidocaine Hydrochloride, Injection, 300 mg/30 mL (1%; 10 mg/mL) (NDC 0409-4279-02) from Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company; availability: "Available"; updated 10/21/2026". This matches exactly. So claim 1 supported.

Claim 2: investigator: "Current stock is 394 units covering 13.6 days at 29 units per day, with a backordered order of 325 units expected 2026-10-24." Cited: [stock-2]. Evidence: "lidocaine LIDOCAINE HYDROCHLORIDE 10 mg/mL (Hospira, Inc., NDC 0409-4279-02, ANDA088329): 394 units on hand, 29/day over 30 days, 13.6 days of cover; open orders: PO-SAMPLE-002 backordered 325 units from Cardinal Health, expected 2026-10-24". Matches. Supported.

Claim 3: investigator: "An ongoing FDA Class II recall by Hospira, Inc. (recall-D-1815-2015) cites particulate matter (iron oxide) in glass vials, but the recall notice does not list our NDC." Cited: [recall-D-1815-2015]. Evidence: "FDA recall D-1815-2015 (Class II, ongoing) by Hospira, Inc.: Presence of Particulate Matter: particulate matter identified as iron oxide, was found embedded in the neck of glass vials." The evidence does not mention whether the recall notice lists our NDC. The claim says "but the recall notice does not list our NDC." The evidence does not provide that information. The recall notice may or may not list the NDC. The evidence only describes the recall reason. The claim makes an assertion about the recall notice not listing our NDC, which is not supported by the evidence. This is a factual problem: the evidence does not state that the recall notice does not list our NDC. So claim 3 is unsupported.

Claim 4: substitution: "Current lidocaine 10 mg/mL from Hospira has 13.6 days of cover." Cited: [stock-2]. Evidence shows 13.6 days of cover. Supported.

Claim 5: substitution: "ANDA208474 is therapeutically equivalent to the current product." Cited: [ob-ANDA208474-001, ob-ANDA088329-001]. Evidence: ob-ANDA208474-001 shows TE code AP for ANDA208474. ob-ANDA088329-001 shows TE code AP for current product. Both have TE code AP, which indicates therapeutic equivalence. The claim says "therapeutically equivalent to the current product." Since both have TE code AP, they are therapeutically equivalent. This is supported.

Claim 6: substitution: "ANDA208474 has no packages on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA208474]. Evidence: "Checked B BRAUN MEDICAL INC ANDA208474: 1 package(s) at our concentration in the FDA product listing (0264-9376-88 by B. Braun Medical Inc.: not on the FDA shortage list); no ongoing recall on these products. Result: none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list." This matches. Supported.

Claim 7: substitution: "ANDA217692 is therapeutically equivalent to the current product." Cited: [ob-ANDA217692-001, ob-ANDA088329-001]. Both have TE code AP. Supported.

Claim 8: substitution: "ANDA217692 has no packages on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA217692]. Evidence: "Checked MANKIND PHARMA LTD ANDA217692: 8 package(s) at our concentration in the FDA product listing ... not on the FDA shortage list ... Result: none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list." Supported.

Claim 9: substitution: "ANDA217693 is therapeutically equivalent to the current product." Cited: [ob-ANDA217693-001, ob-ANDA088329-001]. Both TE code AP. Supported.

Claim 10: substitution: "ANDA217693 has no packages on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA217693]. Evidence: "Checked MANKIND PHARMA LTD ANDA217693: 8 package(s) ... not on the FDA shortage list ... Result: none of its packages at our concentration is on the FDA shortage list." Supported.

Claim 11: substitution: "B BRAUN MEDICAL INC ANDA208474: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA208474, ob-ANDA208474-001, ob-ANDA088329-001, ndc-0264-9376]. The evidence includes status-ANDA208474 (none on shortage list), ob-ANDA208474-001 (TE code AP), ob-ANDA088329-001 (current product TE code AP), ndc-0264-9376 (NDC directory info). The claim is a summary of those. Supported.

Claim 12: substitution: "MANKIND PHARMA LTD ANDA217692: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA217692, ob-ANDA217692-001, ob-ANDA088329-001, ndc-72603-350, ndc-70756-641, ndc-70756-640]. Evidence supports. Supported.

Claim 13: substitution: "MANKIND PHARMA LTD ANDA217693: Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." Cited: [status-ANDA217693, ob-ANDA217693-001, ob-ANDA088329-001, ndc-70756-645, ndc-70756-644, ndc-70756-646]. Evidence supports. Supported.

Thus only claim 3 is unsupported.

We need to output JSON with unsupported list containing that claim.

The format: {"unsupported":[{"claim":string,"agent":"investigator"|"substitution","why":string}]}

For claim 3, agent is "investigator". The claim text is exactly as given: "An ongoing FDA Class II recall by Hospira, Inc. (recall-D-1815-2015) cites particulate matter (iron oxide) in glass vials, but the recall notice does not list our NDC." The why: "The evidence does not state whether the recall notice lists our NDC; it only describes the recall reason."

We must ensure we include the claim text exactly as provided. The claim text includes the agent prefix? The instruction: "Claims (agent: text [cited ids]):" So each claim line includes "investigator: ..." The claim text we should include is the text after the agent? The example in prior answer? The prior answer format: they gave claim text as the full line? In the prior example, they had "claim": "Our package NDC 0409-2305-05 is listed on the FDA shortage list with limited availability due to demand increase, next delivery October 2026 and estimated recovery December 2026." That is the text without the agent prefix. But the instruction says: "Flag only factual problems... Reply as {"unsupported":[{"claim":string,"agent":"investigator"|"substitution","why":string}]}". The claim string should be the claim text (without agent). The agent field indicates which agent. So we should extract the claim text after the colon. For claim 3, the text is "An ongoing FDA Class II recall by Hospira, Inc. (recall-D-1815-2015) cites particulate matter (iron oxide) in glass vials, but the recall notice does not list our NDC." We'll use that.

Thus output:

{
  "unsupported": [
    {
      "claim": "An ongoing FDA Class II recall by Hospira, Inc. (recall-D-1815-2015) cites particulate matter (iron oxide) in glass vials, but the recall notice does not list our NDC.",
      "agent": "investigator",
      "why": "The evidence does not state whether the recall notice lists our NDC; it only describes the recall reason."
    }
  ]
}

Check if any other claims have issues. Claim 11, 12, 13 cite ndc records but those are not needed for the claim but they are provided. The claim says "Therapeutically equivalent (TE code AP) and none of its packages are on the FDA shortage list." The evidence includes status and orange book. The ndc records are extra but not contradictory. So supported.

Thus only claim 3 unsupported.
